steps.label: Load the stage GLB so there is a floor to receive shadows
Custom scene (floor only). A wide, near-static box acts as a shadow-receiving platform centred on the shared camera target (20,20,20); a sphere hangs above it as the caster
Wide flat platform (half-extents 9 x 0.5 x 9), heavy so it barely moves in a few steps
Sphere caster hanging ~6 units above the platform
Let the sphere fall toward the platform
Screenshot: box + sphere cast the shared light's shadow onto the stage floor
One more step so the frame is fresh
Screenshot: same scene, no shadows (cleared shadow depth = nothing occluded)
Invariant: the app is still alive after the shadow toggle + captures
Neg: a non-boolean shadow argument is rejected
